summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Star Fashion Culture Holdings Ltd, a Chinese foreign private issuer, attaching a Notice of an Extraordinary General Meeting and proxy card. The meeting will vote on an ordinary resolution to revise the terms of a previously approved allotment of up to 5,000,000 Class B ordinary shares to Xingji Zhangpingting Limited, changing the consideration mechanism to be determined by a valuation report. This is a routine corporate governance matter and shareholder meeting notice, not a special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. No price, premium, or strategic deal terms are disclosed.
